invariants.name: text_paint_color_shapes_nothing
invariants.note: The Runtime measured no text node again: nothing about what any label says changed.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: No paragraph was laid out again, by the Runtime or by the painter.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_paint_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: The painter drew every label from a layout it already held.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_rasterizes_nothing
invariants.note: No glyph bitmap was produced: the text and its size are what they were.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_uploads_no_atlas_region
invariants.note: No atlas region reached the GPU.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_rebuilds_no_entry
invariants.note: Every label was answered by its retained entry; none was resolved again.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_moves_no_instance
invariants.note: A solid label's glyphs inherit the run row's color, so recoloring it rewrites no instance byte.

invariants.name: text_paint_color_answers_nodes_from_entries
invariants.note: Nodes that reached a draw without resolving a glyph. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be read as 0.

notes: Issue #98 paint-only gate. Every one of a thousand labels changes its foreground color every frame and nothing else. A recolor is a run-row write: no shape, no layout, no raster, no atlas upload, no instance. Work counters are the gate; the timings are host observation. Not Issue #8 weekly DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog.
